question: Should v0.38.4 use this combined release branch as the sole landing path, or should the narrower Homebrew fix land first through https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090?
rationale: Both branches are correct and proof-positive, but this branch additionally freezes release metadata; automation cannot decide the intended release sequencing or publication readiness.

options.title: Land this release branch
options.body: Merge this PR as the sole v0.38.4 source and close the narrower PR as incorporated after the merge.

options.title: Land the narrow fix first
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 and recreate or rebase the v0.38.4 metadata change after release timing is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Land this release branch
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the sole v0.38.4 source and close the narrower PR as incorporated after the merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They published the preceding release and own the commits and serialization context for this patch release.
